slots.jd.residential-hvac.about: Aspen Ridge Mechanical is an owner-run residential heating and cooling company in Salt Lake City. We look after homes in the area, and our technicians work on site in customers' houses every day. We are hiring an HVAC Technician who shows up on time, does careful work and explains it to homeowners in plain words.
slots.jd.residential-hvac.duties:
What the job involves
- Visit homes to inspect heating and cooling systems and estimate jobs for customers
- Diagnose heating and cooling faults and explain the repair options to homeowners
- Test systems for leaks and repair them before recharging
- Install and replace equipment to code
- Keep clear records of each visit and the work done
slots.jd.residential-hvac.needs:
What you need
- 4 or more years of experience as an HVAC technician
- Hands-on skill in heat pump service, system diagnostics and leak testing
- Experience with building automation and thermostat installation
- Brazing and soldering on refrigerant lines
- A Refrigerant Compliance Certificate is required
- A Controls Technician Certificate is preferred
slots.r1.b1: Handles furnace repair calls and keeps work orders complete and current, cutting repeat visits for the same fault by 45 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Carries out preventive maintenance visits, using brazing and soldering to repair worn joints and small line faults before they cause a breakdown.
slots.r1.b3: Installs heating and cooling equipment sized with load calculations, reducing callbacks after installation by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Estimates jobs for customers, including thermostat installation, with clear written quotes that set out parts and labour before work begins.
slots.r1.i1: Works as an HVAC Technician at Evergreen Climate Services, running preventive maintenance visits that keep heating and cooling systems working through the season.
slots.r1.i2: Serves Evergreen Climate Services as an HVAC Technician, testing heating and cooling systems for leaks and making the repairs needed to keep them running safely.
slots.r2.b1: Diagnosed heating and cooling faults, using leak testing to pinpoint refrigerant losses and cutting time to diagnosis by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Tested systems for leaks and used electrical testing to rule out wiring and component faults before a repair began.
slots.r2.b3: Kept work orders for building automation jobs complete and accurate, reducing missing job details by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Assisted on preventive maintenance visits, cleaning, checking and adjusting equipment to the service checklist.
slots.r2.i1: Started as an HVAC Apprentice at Tillman Mechanical, learning to test heating and cooling systems for leaks and find their source.
slots.r2.i2: Trained as an HVAC Apprentice at Tillman Mechanical, where keeping accurate work orders for each job was part of the daily routine.
slots.summary.1: Licensed HVAC technician with 4 years of experience in heating and cooling service, working to code without supervision. Skilled in furnace repair, electrical testing and building automation, and holds a Refrigerant Compliance Certificate.
slots.summary.2: Heating and cooling service technician with about 4 years of hands-on work, from apprenticeship to independent jobs completed to code. Brings practical skill in furnace repair, electrical testing and building automation, along with a state HVAC licence.
